# Recreation Prompt

Create `Moonseed Grove: A Quiet Wander`, a browser-native mobile portrait top-down Canvas game preserving the source mechanics: virtual joystick movement, tap/light attack, held heavy attack, roll/skip dash, enemy pursuit, contact damage, attack arcs, timed spawn escalation, kills/currency/loot level, inventory charms, tool unlocks, HP failure, and restart. Present it as a Studio-Ghibli-inspired fantasy exploration scene with painterly nature, floating magic, cozy melancholy, environmental storytelling, and handmade whimsy. The player is a cloaked child wanderer with a leaf lantern and satchel; enemies are restless soot and forest spirits; rewards are glow-acorns and charms; waves are dusk bells; failure is the grove falling quiet. Use inline CSS/JS/Canvas in a single `index.html`, with mobile-first portrait readability and touch-friendly controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The preserved source is a single-file mobile-first top-down Canvas action survival game. The player moves with a virtual joystick, taps the canvas for a light attack, holds the heavy button for repeated heavy attacks, uses a roll/dash button, opens an inventory panel, equips loot/weapon options, survives escalating waves of pursuing monsters, earns currency and drops from defeated enemies, unlocks weapons by kill thresholds, levels up by currency, loses HP on contact, and restarts after a game-over modal.

## Protected mechanics
- Virtual joystick and keyboard-supported movement.
- Tap/light attack and held heavy attack timing, ranges, damage, and directional dot checks.
- Roll distance, cooldown, clamping, and short invulnerability.
- Enemy spawn-from-edge logic, chase variants, contact damage, hit cooldowns, HP bars, and removal.
- Wave by elapsed time, currency/kills/loot level, inventory bonuses, weapon unlock thresholds, failure/restart.

## Remix blueprint
Rebuild the presentation as `Moonseed Grove: A Quiet Wander`, a painterly fantasy exploration/action game about a small wanderer calming restless forest spirits. The canonical surface stays one inline `index.html` with the same Canvas architecture and mobile controls. Visuals become procedural: watercolor forest hollow, root rings, tree silhouettes, fireflies, falling leaves, child wanderer, soot/wisp/root spirit hazards, handmade HUD panels, and warm lantern feedback.

## Safe theming surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/copy, canvas drawing functions, palette, CSS panels, button labels, audio source emphasis, feedback text, and entity names are safe to transform. Mechanics-facing numeric constants and control semantics are not changed.
